problem_statement: Build a brand-new /segments page ('Audience Segments') from scratch on the Horizon UI Chakra React admin site. The /segments route does not exist yet (baseline is empty). Construct a saved-segment builder that reuses the site's shared Sidebar chrome and Card/brand design system: a header with a 'Save segment' CTA, a KPI row, a filter library of audience filters, and a segment builder where clicking a filter adds a removable chip and a LIVE 'N users match' count recomputes from a fixed 40-user audience. A Match ALL / Match ANY toggle re-composes the count while the accumulated chip set persists. The shared Sidebar nav (Main Dashboard / NFT Marketplace / Data Tables / Profile) must match the sibling /admin pages.
required_content: Page header 'Audience Segments' (h1) with a subtitle and a brand 'Save segment' button
KPI stat row: Total users 40, Active users 28, Pro subscribers 15
'Segment filters' card (h3) holding the accumulated filter chips + a Match ALL / Match ANY mode toggle
A live count heading (h2) reading 'N users match', starting at '40 users match'
'Filter library' card (h3) with clickable filters: Active, Pro plan, US region, Age 30+
Clicking a library filter adds a removable chip; clicking a chip removes it; the live count recomputes each time
Match ALL vs Match ANY toggle re-composes the count over the SAME accumulated chip set (chips persist across the re-render)
A 'Matching users' card previewing users in the current segment
Shared Horizon Sidebar chrome (Main Dashboard / NFT Marketplace / Data Tables / Profile nav) identical to sibling /admin pages

Fixed audience composition (deterministic counts): of the 40 users, 28 are Active and 15 are Pro plan, with exactly 11 users being BOTH Active and Pro — so a Match ALL segment of Active+Pro shows '11 users match' (h2) and switching that same chip set to Match ANY shows '32 users match'.
design_constraints: Reuse the Horizon UI Chakra design system: components/card/Card.js, brand.500 purple, secondaryGray tokens, Chakra spacing/fonts
Mount the shared components/sidebar/Sidebar.js with routes.js so the nav matches sibling /admin routes (cross-page consistency)
Self-contained data: a fixed in-memory 40-user array, no network fetch
Responsive: single-column stack on 390px mobile with no horizontal overflow

Brand palette (must be visibly used): brand purple #422AFB (rgb(66,42,251)) for primary CTA/active accents, page background #F4F7FE, card surfaces #FFFFFF, heading text navy rgb(27,37,89), secondary text gray rgb(163,174,208) — matching the Horizon UI Chakra reference palette.

Stable interaction hooks (required for automated checks): each Filter library button carries data-filter with value "active" (Active), "pro" (Pro plan), "us" (US region) or "age30" (Age 30+); the Match mode toggle exposes data-mode="all" and data-mode="any"; each accumulated chip's remove control carries data-chip equal to its filter id (e.g. data-chip="active").
